note: Hand-made reading of the speech-to-text output (Whisper small.en); nobody has listened. Rows: [first clip, last clip, speaker, event, line as understood, 1 if the reading is a guess]. Speaker is who the line is given to in the simulator: CDR GNR LDR DRV, ANY (any crewman), HQ (the radio net), X (not understood). Clips 521..1041 repeat 0..520 and are not listed.

CDR.drv_back: engine order 'Driver, back up' (and its tense and panic wordings); new AI 'Commander breaks contact'
CDR.drv_fwd: engine orders 'Driver, forward', 'Driver, move out', 'Driver, move'
CDR.hit: engine line 'We are hit. Crew report.' and the commander's reaction to a hit that does not kill
CDR.cease: engine line 'Target. Cease fire.'; main gun round destroys a position
CDR.reengage_doubt: engine line 'Miss. Re-engage.'; new AI 'Main gun round lands close'
CDR.fire: engine line 'Fire, fire, fire! Evacuate!' (the killing hit)
CDR.moveout: new AI: commander moves, shifts, bounds or takes up a position
CDR.reload: new AI 'Loader down: main gun needs loading'
CDR.loader_down: new AI 'Loader hit while up in his hatch'
CDR.ready: crew report at the start of a battle
GNR.ontheway: engine line 'On the way' (30 mm burst, main gun in a tank duel)
GNR.target: engine line 'Target'; new AI 'knocked out by machine-gun fire'
GNR.ready: engine lines 'Gunner up', 'Gunner is good'; crew report at the start of a battle
GNR.range: new AI 'Gunner lays on ..., x km': the nearest range call
GNR.mg: new AI: the gunner's coax engages a team
LDR.ready: engine lines 'Sabot loaded', 'Loader up', 'Loader is good'; crew report at the start of a battle
LDR.mg_ready: new AI 'Loader up on the M240'
DRV.ack_fwd: engine answers 'Moving', 'Moving out'; new AI move orders
DRV.ready: engine lines 'Driver up', 'Driver is good'; crew report at the start of a battle
ANY.wound: new AI 'Loader hit while up in his hatch' (the loader's own cry)
DRV.track: a hit that breaks a track: needs a mobility-kill outcome in the battle layer
DRV.trans: mobility kill: needs a damage model
DRV.engine_fire: engine hit: needs a damage model
DRV.fuel: fuel hit: needs a damage model
DRV.power: engine hit: needs a damage model
DRV.engine_back: needs a damage and repair model
DRV.onmove: could answer any move order instead of 'Roger, moving forward'
GNR.id_tank: tank duel: the gunner's 'Identified' (the engine uses the same word for a missile, so it is not wired)
GNR.sense_left: main gun miss: where the round fell (needs the miss direction from the battle layer)
GNR.sense_right: main gun miss: where the round fell
GNR.sense_high: main gun miss: where the round fell
GNR.sense_low: main gun miss: where the round fell
GNR.cdr_down: commander wounded: needs crew casualties in the battle layer
GNR.gun_out: weapon station or main gun knocked out: needs a damage model
GNR.fcs_out: sights or radar knocked out: needs a damage model
GNR.topmg_out: could be used for the weapon station being knocked out
CDR.fire_out: after a fire: needs a damage model
CDR.load_he: main gun on a dug-in team: 'Load HE' before the shot (needs the round type in the shot record)
CDR.load_heat: main gun on a dug-in team: the M1A2 would fire HEAT or the multi-purpose round
CDR.load_canister: main gun on infantry inside 500 m
CDR.trav_left: commander slews the gunner onto a target to the left
CDR.trav_right: commander slews the gunner onto a target to the right
HQ.hq_start: start of a mission (advance or hunt)
HQ.hq_end_won: end of a battle that the vehicle wins
HQ.hq_withdraw: end of a battle where the vehicle breaks contact
HQ.hq_incoming: enemy mortars or artillery, if they are ever added
